summary: Bridgewater Bancshares filed an 8-K to disclose that its board extended the expiration of its existing 2022 stock repurchase program by one year, from August 26, 2026 to August 25, 2027. At the time, $12.4 million remained under the authorization. The program permits open-market or privately negotiated repurchases, subject to Rule 10b-18 and possible 10b5-1 plans. This is a routine capital management update, not a special situation; no terms, prices, or accelerations were announced. The extension reflects ongoing capacity rather than a distinct event, so no further action is indicated.
